name: Koe ni Koi Shite, Koikogare!
source:
Our protagonist is attending school with the goal of becoming an audio specialist.

When his father is suddenly transferred, he finds himself in danger of not being able to attend school!

It's a shame that his younger sister, Hinata, who aspires to be a voice actress, will also have to transfer schools.

Is there any way they can earn enough to live on their own...?

The three of them, including their childhood friend Akari, a singer, decide to sell audio content...!

Will this erotic sales strategy that they are betting on be a success?

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1142513]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
主角正在学校里学习，以成为声音领域的专业人士为目标。

然而，父亲突然被调职，让他面临无法继续就读的危机！

梦想成为声优的妹妹Hinata，也不得不转学，实在让人遗憾。

有没有办法，能赚到足够的钱，让他们独立生活呢……？

于是，加上身为歌手的青梅竹马明莉，三人决定贩售音声作品……！

这场赌上梦想的情色销售作战，究竟能否成功？
